## ABOUT

:::::: columns
::: {.column width="45%"}
My name is Rimjhim Saxena (Pronounced : *Rim-Jim Sax-éna*). I am a **Researcher at the Institute of Economics and Econometrics (IEE) at the Geneva School of Economics and Management (GSEM) at the University of Geneva, Switzerland**. I graduated with my PhD in Economics from the [University of Colorado, Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/economics/) in May 2025. I like working at the intersection of Climate + Labor + Development, preferably with a good coffee.

I worked as a Pre-Doctoral Fellow at [Environmental Defense Fund](https://www.edf.org) in Summer of 2021 at the Office of Chief Economist. Before starting graduate school, I worked as a Research Assistant at [Center for the Advanced Study of India, University of Pennsylvania](https://casi.sas.upenn.edu). I hold a Masters degree in Economics from [Boston University](https://www.bu.edu/econ/), MBA in Finance and Bachelors in Industrial Engineering from Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, India (#10 engineering school in India, #997 globally).
